summary: Introduction to the ansible-core 2.12 porting guide describing changes from ansible-core 2.11, to be read with the 2.12 changelog.
questions: Where do I start when upgrading to ansible-core 2.12?

answer_card.title: ansible-core 2.11 → 2.12 overview
answer_card.answer_md: The ansible-core **2.12** porting guide lists behaviour changes since **2.11** that may require updates to playbooks, plugins and other content. Read it together with the ansible-core 2.12 changelog.
